403.title: You do not have access here.
403.description: Your account needs the required permission to view this page.
403.hint: Contact your project manager or check your account from the sign-in page.

404.title: We could not find this page.
404.description: The address may be incorrect, the content may have been removed, or it may no longer be available.
404.hint: Check the address or return home to continue with your projects.

500.title: Something went wrong.
500.description: PDA encountered an unexpected problem while opening this page.
500.hint: Try again. If the problem persists, tell us which action you were taking.

503.title: We are taking a short break.
503.description: PDA cannot handle this request right now. The service may be temporarily unavailable.
503.hint: Try again in a moment. If there is a connection problem, check your internet connection too.

common.label: PDA · Something interrupted your work
common.testDescription: The button triggers a controlled error on this page. Try again returns you to this screen.
